# ADR-0020: Durable tool steps for broker builds and measures

> **Status:** accepted | **Date:** 2026-08-04

**References:** [ADR-0005](../adr/ADR-0005.md), [ADR-0017](../adr/ADR-0017.md), [ADR-0019](../adr/ADR-0019.md)

## Context

Every completed piece of expensive broker work lived in memory and died with the pod. The codegen memo and built provenance set were in-memory mutexes. Broker restart forced rebuilds; a 90-minute GPU oracle was repaid in full after any restart.

## Decision

A durable step is a unit of work whose completed result is an immutable value, recorded in an append-only NDJSON ledger keyed by content of inputs. Semantics: at-least-once-executed, exactly-once-recorded. Only settled facts are recorded (Ok is recorded, Err/transport is not; a deterministic measured failure IS a fact). Eligibility: values, never state (deploy_candidate is NOT a step). The ledger is a cache, never authoritative. Amends ADR-0017's cache section for the broker half.

## Consequences

Replay covers broker restart within a live pod. Replayed replies carry cached:true. Mid-job pod death orphans the Kueue Job (at-least-once accepted for v1). A cached compile error could mask a fix outside tree+config (narrow exposure window).

## Alternatives Considered

### Durable step: immutable value in append-only NDJSON ledger keyed by input content (accepted)


### In-memory cache with periodic checkpoint to disk (rejected)

- **Rejected because:** Periodic checkpoints lose work between snapshots. The append-only ledger records each completed step immediately, so a restart replays from the full history.
